claims: Howard University is in Washington, D.C.
The Howard Bison and Lady Bison represent Howard University.
The Howard Bison and Lady Bison compete in NCAA Division I.
The Howard Bison and Lady Bison are members of the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference (MEAC).
The Howard Bison and Lady Bison adopted a charging bison logo in 2015.
Howard University's men's basketball team secured their first-ever NCAA tournament win in 2026.
Howard University's men's and women's basketball teams qualified for the NCAA tournament.
